body:
I’ll be speaking at Duke University on Wednesday, then I’ll be in LA Thursday – Sunday.

Thursday I’ll be doing some filming related to my upcoming book …

Then Saturday I’ll be with the Episcopal diocese, and Sunday I’ll be speaking at All Souls Church in Pasadena.

Saturday night I’ll be speaking at Fuller Seminary.

If you’re in the area(s), I hope you’ll come out and say hi!
